about: The retarget ledger (cmd/wltest/README.md, "The retarget ledger"): what a pull request into the retarget branch rt/retarget knowingly leaves failing while windmill-lite moves to Windmill 1.862.0 and Bun 1.4.3, each entry with the retarget milestone that clears it and a one-line reason. flow_suite lists required runs of TestFlowSuite that may fail or be unsupported in the modes an entry names (every mode when it names none); step_suite lists step cases of TestStepSuite the same way; oracle lists runs whose recording is pending, which wltest record --check --pending may report new, changed, expect_mismatch, failed or unstable, and which the recording tests of internal/oracle accept without a recording. Items are named from the repository root: <fixture directory>/<run>, <expression file>/<case> or <step file>/<case>. A pull request removes the entries it clears and adds entries only for the failures it knowingly causes. This file exists only on rt/retarget: wltest ledger --base main fails while it exists, so the pull request that merges the branch into main deletes it.

conformance/flows/oracle/probes/env.reason: the recorded bun field is the oracle image's Bun 1.3.10 and the engine now runs the pinned Bun 1.4.3, a difference the env probe cannot carry until it is a named deviation

conformance/steps/bun/d11.yaml/d11-refus.reason: Bun 1.4.3 words the RangeError for an out-of-range exit code differently (&& and digit separators); the code is still refused

conformance/steps/bun/d11.yaml/d11-top-l.reason: on Bun 1.4.3 a process.exit at a warm module's top level escapes the harness and ends the process

conformance/steps/bun/d18.yaml/d18-b-nam.reason: Bun 1.4.3's bundler lists the keys of an import * namespace sorted

conformance/steps/bun/wa-31.yaml/wa-31-n.reason: on Bun 1.4.3 a settled node:http request leaves a handle that settlement reports as left_behind
